description: This file is a shell script for testing a Git post-merge hook. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and assertions to verify the behavior of the post-merge hook in different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and verifies their success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the test.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a Git hook for testing, either for setup or verification.
